purpose: isolate whether the training-time action horizon contract contributes to joint32 failure
fixed_variables: dataset bytes, episode list and task metadata
batch size, optimizer, scheduler, precision and seed
checkpoint cadence and no-overwrite output policy
calibrated V3 evaluator, task 0 benchmark init protocol and EGL runtime

evaluation_plan_after_explicit_training_.primary_gate: success_rate > 0/20 and not attributable to evaluator drift
evaluation_plan_after_explicit_training_.replication_gate: improvement at two checkpoints or on an independent init subset

alternatives_rejected_for_now.n_action_steps10: larger protocol change and less direct historical V3 match

approval_boundary: No training or evaluation is launched by this draft; explicit user approval is required.
